I chose to remove spin-frame calibration from an entire encoded computation. The resulting construction has two linked parts:

A common unknown static spin frame can become part of the encoding. When loading, transport, charge interactions, measurement and return all share that frame, the complete computation can work without reconstructing individual spin-rotation angles.
Its native singlet/triplet measurement needs only one qualified charge resonance at a time. I proved a transfer-and-return bound that retains both double-charge states, allows unequal quantum source operators, and places no bandwidth or detuning bound on the other double-charge sector.

I also derived a microscopic improvement to the error model: in a qualified [110] semiconductor envelope model, choosing the encoding around the actual time-reversed band minima absorbs the linear part of the cubic Dresselhaus correction. The remaining spin-dependent error is cubic in momentum relative to those minima.

These are working theoretical results with executable checks. They establish a broader information/control capability; they do not yet establish a device operating window. The protected tunnel cycle and its qualifications remain preserved as a separate construction.

P2 chose a substantially different apparatus principle. A single static classical pure-gauge spin connection across the particle domain is incorporated into the fermionic encoding. Conjugation makes the actual many-particle Hamiltonian spin independent while retaining interacting orbital motion, potentials and a noncommuting retained apparatus. Charge measurement dilations, preparation and return must be covariant under the SAME frame; then intermediate frame changes cancel along the complete apparatus record. Local singlet-pair loading is SU(2)-invariant. A supplied encoded singlet/triplet program therefore transfers without individually reconstructing the spatial spin angles. This does not give identity transfer to an unrelated external spin frame.

The harder contact theorem now qualifies one charge resonance at a time while retaining both double-charge states. The off-target charge Hamiltonian and common source bandwidth are unrestricted, subject to existence of the admitted dynamics. The source-control worker strengthens an earlier Dyson bound by using exact block equations, and charges double-sector perturbations only after a contact reaches them. Its reverse propagator is an analytical proof device, not a supplied physical bath reversal. Every occupied-site return setting still needs its own qualification after admitted histories.
